name: purs-puppy
description: An LR parser generator for PureScript
author: katsujukou

scripts.bundle: spago build -p puppy-cli --pure --output output-cli && purs-backend-es bundle-module -p node -y -m Puppy.CLI.Main --corefn-dir output-cli --output-dir output-cli-es -t ./dist/lib/bundle.js
scripts.prepack: npm run copy && npm run bundle
scripts.version: echo 'export const version = "v'$npm_package_version'";' > ./cli/src/Puppy/CLI/Version.js && git add package.json ./cli/src/Puppy/CLI/Version.js
